releases.displayName: New Game Announcement + Update on Hexologic

items.text: Hello Hexologic & Puzzle fans from all around the planet! 👋

We're super excited for two reasons. First thing is - Hexologic will be getting another update next month, focused on some of the stuff you recently reported and were kind enough to share on our Steam forums.

Last month with a Free-To-Keep deal on Steam, we welcomed more than 1.5 million new players who added Hexologic to their Steam libraries. Reviews and feedback kept flowing, player base kept growing and we were humbled to see all the kind words (100% from recent reviews!) about our puzzle gem.
So our next game is our tribute to you guys - fans of puzzlers that appreciate the challenge and want to exercise their braincells - and send some undead to the oblivion when doing it!
Ladies & Gentlemen... Enter the world of Dungoku and check out the brand new announcement trailer!
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/BMigahgDeBA"]
🔢 Sudoku meets dungeon crawling: Use logic and deduction to locate hidden monsters on a grid-based dungeon map.
[p align="justify"]⚖️ Risk and reward: Make the right call to earn gold, or face the consequences of a wrong guess.
[p align="justify"]🛠️ 100+ handcrafted dungeons: Explore increasingly more complex environments as you descend the Spire.
[p align="justify"]⚔️ 70+ weapons, armour and items: Build your arsenal and improve your chances of survival as every item offers a different strategic buff.
[p align="justify"]👹 20+ monsters: Face skeletons, zombies and a variety of other undead enemies.
[p align="justify"]👾 Classic pixel-art presentation: A distinctive visual style built around retro palettes.
[p align="justify"]🔮 Retro dark fantasy atmosphere: Atmospheric ambient sounds and human-composed music bring the world to life.
Wishlist Dungoku ahead of its launch next month!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5554930/Dungoku/"]

items.text: Hi everyone 👋

Long time no see! Just wanted to let you know that Hexologic runs perfectly fine on Steam Deck - oof what a suprise! 😅 The game has a download size of 446MB and also supports touch screen controls and that's pretty much it - we're still waiting for the official Steam Deck support green tick.
Experiencing any issues on Steam Deck or any other platforms? Let us know on Discord.
MythicOwl Team

releases.displayName: Hexologic Linux Update - Infinite Mode Added!

items.text: Hello everyone!
Here we are with a long awaited update for many of our fans here - Hexologic on Linux receives the most recent content update, the great Infinite Mode!

We updated the code, added a bunch of improvements and build updates to make it a smooth experience, whether you're on x64 or x86. We noticed that some of you experienced progress loss and registering issues and they should be history with today's update.
As always, we are looking forward to your feedback on both our Steam Discussions or Discord, so feel free to join and take part in improving our current and upcoming games. ːsteamhappyː
👉 https://discord.gg/e69WDgdbKW 👈
What can you expect joining our community?
🎁 Giveaways (including our award-winning puzzler Hexologic!)
😃 Most awesome puzzle recommendations
💎 Exclusive content from Harmony's Odyssey - not available anywhere else
🛠️ Work-in-progress content (including some of our most crazy ideas!)
🎨 The most awesome concept art and drawings from our talented team - added one today! ;)
📅 First hand info about events, expo's and fairs
🤣 Fun!
